active_default_renderer_contract.value: RendererContract defaults to the fragment backend with the Kerr reference geodesic model

output_validation_scenes_metrics.value: rendered_output_validation measures shipping pixels against analytic oracles: the Schwarzschild critical curve within 1 px (CI on Mesa llvmpipe), and with BLACKHOLE_RENDER_FULL=1 the disk limb, signed Kerr shadow displacement, disk rotation, and quality-tier exhaustion on a GL 4.6 GPU

backend_availability_parity.value: fragment, compute, and CUDA render the backlit Schwarzschild scene with MAE 0 on an RTX 4070 Ti; this is plumbing parity over shared or ported code, and CUDA needs an NVIDIA GL context for interop

performance_tiers.value: default Kerr fragment path 2.12 ms median GPU at 1324x1032 on an RTX 4070 Ti at the startup camera; the reference tier covers twice the selected affine range at step 0.02; interactive and production latency budgets per scene remain unmeasured

physical_approximations.value: thin-disk and analytic shadow tests omit emissive image calibration

authoritative_game_session_type.value: game::CampaignSession for canonical campaign; game::ConstellationSession for multi-system contest

deterministic_test_replay_status.value: campaign_realtime_determinism_validation and constellation_validation are configured tests; execution is recorded separately

canonical_scenario_completion_tests.value: campaign_balance_invariant_validation and campaign_colony_outcome_validation exercise canonical campaign outcomes
